caption:
How to write holiday hours for every channel at once with AI

Door sign, social story, website banner, a text to regulars, your map listing. Same hours, five places, and somehow one always ends up with the wrong date.

Copy this:

"My holiday hours: [DATES + HOURS]. Write versions for: 1) door sign 2) social story 3) website banner 4) text to regular clients 5) map listing note. Same facts in each, each at its natural length."

I tried it with a sample salon schedule: the sign came back short and blunt, the story friendly, and the text to regulars even offered a pre-holiday slot.

The tip: check the dates once in the prompt, against your calendar. If the source is right, all five versions are right.

Send this to someone who still types their hours five times. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
